last.status: Playback paused. Resume when you are ready.

offline: Not measured: reload uses live HTTP; only IndexedDB persistence was checked.
controls: Scripted File inputs, buttons and controlled animation clock. Before the single deliberate Arm, up to ten zero-time frames remain paused with unchanged ticks until two frames take at most 250 ms each; all timings remain recorded. Transparent renderer forwarding observes existing draw states during active playback; full host snapshots run only outside active playback and the final snapshot identity must equal the final draw. Actual RAF callback-entry gaps are recorded without changing the performance clock. Production focus/pause guards remain active, with no automatic resume. No physical-device or player acceptance claim.
lifecycle: Native iframe reload and teardown only; no explicit app.dispose qualification or WebGL leak claim.
